svg.aria-label: One card, one chat model, a bounded cache: 1. Model: The pod downloads a Q3_K_M GGUF of the chat model on first start into a 50 Gi claim. A 30-minute startup probe covers that download. 2. Card: The pod takes the single Arc Pro B70 through devic.es/b70 and runs llama.cpp on SYCL. vLLM cannot finish warming up this model on one card (intel/llm-scaler#382). 3. Cache: A prompt cache capped at 4096 MiB, with a glibc tunable and the oneDNN attention pin, keeps host memory from growing without a bound. 4. Priority: The chat-gpu-high class outranks CI runners and tdarr, so the 8-CPU request is always schedulable on talos-3. 5. Alias: The server is named ${CHAT_MODEL_ID}. LiteLLM reaches it at vllm-app on port 8000 as chat-local, so consumers never see the real model name.
